title: Alice Dance Studio
descr: A dance studio web application built with Next.js that allows users to browse dance classes, instructors, and schedules, while providing e-commerce functionality for purchasing class passes. The site includes admin controls for managing content and integrates payment processing via Stripe. It's deployed on Vercel.
flow: The app loads class and instructor data at render time (layout.tsx), preloading it into Redux state. The Clerk middleware protects admin routes and requires authentication for non-public pages. Users browse classes (with filters), add passes to a cart, proceed to Stripe checkout, and track orders in their account. Admins can manage content via admin dashboard.
